comment: Service levels and semantic conformance are included in operational governance, but the section does not require objective acceptance criteria or independent verification for critical components.

public.text: Service levels and semantic conformance are included in operational governance, but the section does not require objective acceptance criteria or independent verification for critical components.
public.suggestedRevision: Require measurable service-level indicators, conformance test results, data-quality thresholds, security controls, and evidence of independent or governance-approved verification before major releases become operational.
